sources.title: Stylistic Contrastive Learning for Human-Like AI Text Generation
sources.snippet: Contrastive learning supplies an explicit repulsive signal away from the AI-style 135 cluster and an attractive signal toward human-style centroids, across multiple dimensions (lexicon, 136 idiom, discourse). This differs from likelihood-only fine-tuning, which lacks a style-aware target 137 and thus retains "safe" defaults [5, 16, 17].
